title: Branding Agency Malta | Logo Designs - Keen Ltd

facts.fact: Keen says a logo design concept can be turned around within two days of starting the job when it has a thorough brief from the client.
facts.quote: If we have a thorough brief from the client, then the concept and design of a logo can be easily turned around within two days of starting the job.

facts.fact: Keen says it usually gives clients a choice of 3 or 4 logo ideas to choose from.
facts.quote: Usually a choice of 3 or 4 ideas are given to the client to choose from.

facts.fact: Keen states the initial branding process may take between 2 and 4 months, depending on how refined the ideas are and how cohesive the directions within the entrepreneurial group are.
facts.quote: The initial branding process may take between 2-4 months depending on how refined your ideas are and how cohesive the directions within the entrepreneurial group are.

facts.fact: Keen cites many marketeers' belief that a strong brand can take between 2 and 5 years to establish fully, subject to market.
facts.quote: Many marketeers believe a strong brand can take anything between 2 and 5 years to establish fully but always subject to market.

facts.fact: Keen says it can help clients register a trademark through the IPS online system.
facts.quote: Keen can help you register your trademark through the IPS online system.

facts.fact: Keen states that to start a logo concept it requires the full company name, the market sector the company operates in, and a brief or direction on the envisioned branding concept if one exists.
facts.quote: Keen requires the full name of the company and details of which market sector it operates in, as well as a brief/direction of what you are envisioning vis-a-vis a branding concept – if you have one.

facts.fact: Keen's branding process includes a final step of compiling a comprehensive brand guideline book.
facts.quote: Our team compiles a comprehensive brand guideline book to help you stay on track and assure effective brand positioning from day one.
